MECAD Systems, based in Samrand Business Park, Centurion, is South Africa's most experienced SOLIDWORKS partner, recognised by Dassault Systemes after almost four decades partnering with engineering and manufacturing companies. Its offering spans the full SOLIDWORKS product line, including 3D CAD design, SOLIDWORKS Simulation, Plastics and Flow Simulation, SOLIDWORKS Electrical, and the 2D CAD tool DraftSight, alongside 3DEXPERIENCE cloud design and collaboration products.

Beyond software licensing, MECAD provides training and technical support to help engineering teams work faster and more accurately, with specialised packages for entrepreneurs and startups, academia, and manufacturing and production environments including SOLIDWORKS CAM and PDM data management. Its sister company, MECAD Manufacturing, is the sole reseller of Mastercam for Sub-Saharan Africa. Based in Louwlardia, Centurion, MECAD Systems suits engineering and manufacturing businesses needing CAD, CAM and simulation software backed by local training and support.

MH Marketing Management, based in Erasmuskloof, Pretoria, was founded in 2020 and previously traded as MJH Marketing, drawing on more than eight years of combined experience in the marketing and automotive industries. The business connects automotive brands with marketing professionals rather than running campaigns in-house, acting as the link between the two sides of a marketing project.

Its role covers the full lifecycle of that connection, from campaign planning through to reporting and claims handling once a campaign is live, giving automotive brands a managed process rather than a one-off introduction. Based in Erasmuskloof, Pretoria, MH Marketing Management suits automotive brands needing marketing professionals sourced and managed for a specific campaign rather than building that capability internally.

CMH Mitsubishi Menlyn, part of the Combined Motor Holdings group, stocks a full range of new Mitsubishi vehicles including the Pajero Sport, Triton, Xpander, ASX, Eclipse Cross and Outlander, alongside a wide selection of used vehicles in its own pre-owned department. Customers can browse new vehicle specs, safety and comfort features online before visiting the showroom or booking a test drive.

The dealership also runs a dedicated finance department and after-sales service and parts operation, and has won the Dealer of the Year award in the Service After Sales category at the Mitsubishi Motors South Africa Annual Awards. Open Monday to Friday from 7:30am to 5pm and Saturdays from 8am to 1pm, CMH Mitsubishi Menlyn suits buyers wanting a new or used Mitsubishi backed by a dealer group recognised for its after-sales service.

Mokhine Group, based in Garsfontein, Pretoria East, began as a small civil construction contractor in 2007 and has grown into a turnkey construction and facilities-management solutions provider. Its construction work covers retaining walls, and road, tunnel and railway construction, placing it among contractors handling heavier civil infrastructure rather than purely residential building.

The company has also taken on hospital engineering and construction works, a specialised niche requiring compliance with healthcare facility standards alongside standard construction practice. Based in Garsfontein, Pretoria East, Mokhine Group suits public and private clients needing civil infrastructure, specialised hospital construction or ongoing facilities management handled by one contractor.

Montana Granite Tombstones Pretoria, founded in 1984 in Booysens, manufactures and retails memorial tombstones using only real granite and marble, with lettering and installation included in every price. The business does its own manufacturing to keep 100% control over delivery dates, important when a family is working towards a specific unveiling date.

Its range covers budget, standard, executive, double and children's headstones, fitted with a unique patented fastening method designed to stop tombstones shifting or falling over time. The company also installs lintels on graves younger than three years at a small additional cost. Based in Booysens, Pretoria, Montana Granite Tombstones suits families across Gauteng needing a tombstone manufactured, lettered and installed by a single supplier rather than coordinating separate trades.

Mpresif Marketing & Consulting, based in Wonderboom South, Pretoria, provides marketing services for small and medium businesses in Pretoria, Centurion and Johannesburg, built around helping each client understand what motivates its customers and what strategy will improve the business. Its offering includes strategic marketing advice and coaching, online workshops and assessments, and social media management, design and setup across Facebook and Instagram.

The business also handles email marketing, content writing for websites and company profiles, graphic design and branding, and builds off-the-shelf websites for clients needing an online presence quickly. Based in Wonderboom South, Pretoria, Mpresif Marketing & Consulting suits small business owners wanting one consultant across strategy, content and design rather than separate specialists for each.

MTD Research Specialists, founded in 2009 and based in Pretoria North, is a socio-economic research firm operating with a strategic and flexible organisational model built around a core team of full-time researchers. Its work spans feasibility studies, market intelligence, economic research and trade policy studies for clients needing evidence before making a decision rather than relying on assumptions.

The firm also carries out valuation and due-diligence work, survey design, and data capturing, analysis and report-writing for public, private and voluntary-sector clients across different kinds of projects. Based in Derdepoort, Pretoria, MTD Research Specialists suits organisations needing independent research, feasibility or valuation work rather than conducting it themselves in-house.

Myfamily Projects and Consulting, established in 2013 and based in Heatherview, Pretoria, is a 100% black women-owned management consulting and skills development firm accredited by QCTO and Services SETA, with an additional memorandum of understanding from ETDP SETA. The business exists to help organisations and communities manage their projects successfully and cost-effectively, pairing project oversight with training that makes a client more competitive and compliant.

Its services cover consulting and project management, material development and review, human resources services, and skills development training and talent shaping for clients across both the private and public sectors. Based in Heatherview, Pretoria, Myfamily Projects and Consulting suits organisations needing project management support alongside accredited training rather than the two handled separately.

Ndabase Printing Solutions, established in 2007, grew from a small quick-print shop of 128 square metres and three employees into a nationally recognised commercial printer with more than 15 years in the industry, servicing clients across education, retail, government and media throughout Africa. The 100% black-owned, Level 1 B-BBEE company offers litho, digital and wide-format printing alongside finishing services such as lamination, UV varnishing, die cutting, folding and embossing.

In July 2023 the Pretoria branch relocated its printing factory to Samrand Business Park, a move aimed at enhancing production and ensuring on-time dispatch and delivery to clients, with its contact details staying unchanged through the move. Based in Kosmosdal, Pretoria, Ndabase Printing Solutions suits businesses needing litho, digital or wide-format printing finished and delivered from a single, recently upgraded production facility.

NJW Engineering, established in 2007 in Rosslyn, offers structural steel design, fabrication and erection along with the rolling of cold-formed lipped channel, working throughout Southern Africa from a 4,000 square metre workshop served by six overhead cranes. The company specialises in industrial, commercial and residential property, as well as alterations and additions to existing large-scale facilities such as student housing, complexes and high-rise residential developments.

Alongside construction work, NJW aims to involve, train and uplift local communities where its projects are based, treating community upliftment as a goal running through its projects rather than a side activity. Based in Rosslyn, Pretoria, NJW Engineering suits office, commercial, industrial and mining clients needing structural steelwork and cold forming handled by one Southern African contractor.

Palms Guest House, in the Moot area of Pretoria, is a luxurious 3-star bed and breakfast within walking distance of Eugene Marais Hospital and major shopping centres, offering 14 luxury double and single rooms and five family and self-catering units. A spacious honeymoon suite comes equipped with its own kitchenette and Jacuzzi, and the property provides safe, secure parking for guests.

Beyond accommodation, Palms Guest House hosts corporate functions, weddings in its on-site chapel, conferences, matric farewells and bachelor parties, with catering available for any of these events. Based in Eloffsdal, Pretoria, Palms Guest House suits travellers wanting comfortable accommodation as much as those planning a wedding or function without needing a separate venue.

Platinum Iris Rhenosterfontein Depot is a depot of Platinum Iris, a petroleum industry company founded in 2014 that has grown into an integrated business specialising in the wholesale of petroleum products. Health, Safety, Security and Environment practices are built into the company's operations as a stated priority, alongside a commitment to first-class customer service and dedicated staff.

The company positions itself on high-quality products at affordable prices, backed by excellent after-service, and runs a social responsibility programme focused on enhancing the lives of people with special needs. Based in Donkerhoek, Platinum Iris Rhenosterfontein Depot suits businesses and bulk customers needing wholesale petroleum products from a supplier that puts safety and customer service at the centre of its operation.

Prosperitas Personnel, based in Wierdapark, Centurion, is a recruitment and executive search agency combining 30 years of specialist experience across finance, engineering, supply chain and IT. The agency delivers recruitment services across South Africa, within the rest of Africa and in the United Arab Emirates, giving it reach beyond the local market most agencies its size cover.

Its specialism in C-level and executive search assignments means it strategically partners with clients to identify, source, recruit and deliver key leadership talent rather than simply filling vacancies, with close attention paid to the finer details that keep a client ahead in a fast-moving business world. Based in Wierdapark, Centurion, Prosperitas Personnel suits businesses needing senior leadership or scarce, specialist talent sourced through a dedicated executive search process.

PSG Silver Lakes Wealth Management & Stockbroking, at Hazeldean Office Park in Silver Lakes, is a financial and fiduciary advisory office forming part of the PSG Financial Services group, offering wealth management, stockbroking and estate planning services. Its advisers work with individuals, businesses and professional investors, tailoring advice to each category rather than offering a single standard package.

As part of the wider PSG network, the branch draws on the group's national resources and financial planning expertise while focusing specifically on the private client market around Silver Lakes. Open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm, PSG Silver Lakes Wealth Management & Stockbroking is based in Hazeldean, Pretoria, and suits private clients wanting wealth management, stockbroking and estate planning advice from one established financial services group.

PSI CRO South Africa, based at Highveld Techno Park in Centurion, is the local office of PSI CRO, a global Clinical Research Organization that conducts clinical trials and research work on behalf of pharmaceutical and biotech clients. Operating as part of PSI's international network, the South African office gives local sponsors and investigators access to a globally coordinated clinical trials infrastructure rather than a purely local research operation.

That international backing matters in clinical research, where trial data often needs to meet standards recognised across multiple countries and regulatory bodies rather than South Africa alone. Based in Bronberrik, Centurion, PSI CRO South Africa suits pharmaceutical and biotech sponsors needing clinical trial management and research support delivered through an internationally networked CRO.

Quill Associates, a 100% South African-owned IT business software company established in Pretoria in 1988, developed the BIQ business performance system, first implemented at Brits Municipality in 1994 and still in use by municipal councils across South Africa, Zimbabwe and Namibia. BIQ is built as a complete, GRAP-compliant municipal ERP, positioned as a reliable system that enhances revenue and optimises employee productivity through automated, integrated processes.

Its modules cover property databases, GIS, prepaid services and cell phone meter reading, receipting, grave and voter registers, payroll, emergency services such as ambulance and fire prevention, call centre management, general ledger and budget management, supply chain, asset and fleet management, and human resources. Based in Rietvalleirand, Pretoria, Quill Associates suits municipalities needing one integrated ERP system rather than several disconnected pieces of software.

RAM Centurion is a courier hub of RAM Hand-to-Hand Couriers, part of a national network of more than 40 local hubs running over 2,000 vehicles and 75 bikes, supported by more than 3,000 permanent staff and over 20,000 square metres of warehouse space. The network handles everything from a single parcel to a full supply chain solution, offering same-day, next-day or economy road delivery nationally and internationally.

The company also runs industry-specific solutions for sectors including beauty and cosmetics, financial services, IT and cellular, pharmaceutical and retail, each with different handling and timing requirements. Based in Rooihuiskraal, Centurion, RAM Centurion suits businesses needing parcels moved reliably within a sector-aware national network rather than a generic courier service.

REGENT Business School's Pretoria campus, in Hillcrest Office Park, belongs to a private higher-education institution established in 1998 as a post-apartheid empowerment institution and now part of the Honoris United Universities network. It offers flexible study options, including full-time, part-time and online programmes, spanning certificates, diplomas, degrees, honours, masters and doctoral DBA qualifications.

Its business studies offering includes MBA and diploma programmes designed to give individuals and organisations management and leadership skills applicable across sectors. Open Monday to Friday from 8am to 4:30pm and Saturdays from 9am to 2pm, REGENT Business School's Pretoria campus suits working professionals wanting flexible study options through to doctoral level rather than committing to a rigid full-time schedule alone.

Rubrix Community Living Administrators is a managing agent helping trustees effectively manage sectional title and community schemes by providing sound financial data, legal compliance resources and industry-leading reporting tools. Its services cover administrative management, financial management, budgeting and maintenance guidance, legal compliance, community relations and insurance management for the schemes it administers.

The company is registered with the PPRA and the National Association of Managing Agents, giving clients assurance that its practices meet recognised industry standards for scheme administration. Based in Rietondale, Pretoria, Rubrix Community Living Administrators suits trustees and boards wanting day-to-day scheme administration, financial oversight and AGM coordination handled by an accredited managing agent rather than volunteers.

Rylo Industrial Solutions, based in Silvertondale, Pretoria, operates across several specialised divisions delivering industrial equipment, construction, cleaning chemicals, and service and repairs under one group. Its Equipment division supplies compressors, generators, pumps and other machinery, while its Chemicals division formulates its own cleaning agents in-house for efficiency and consistent quality.

The Construction division handles custom wash bay installations, shade structures and site development, and Service & Repairs keeps equipment running through qualified technicians, with the business rated highly by its customers and delivering nationwide. Based in Silvertondale, Pretoria, Rylo Industrial Solutions suits businesses wanting equipment, installation, cleaning and repair solutions sourced from one specialised group rather than separate suppliers.

Samrand Panel Beaters specialises in dent, scratch and hail damage repairs, auto body repairs, panel replacement and spray painting, backed by an in-house paint bank for precise colour mixing and matching. The business also provides mobile paintless dent removal nationwide, bringing the repair service to a vehicle rather than requiring it to be dropped off.

Its director holds a National Certificate in Panel Beating and Spray Painting and additional training as a Paintless Dent Technician, and the business is a registered service provider for Miway Insurance, M-Sure Insurance and Wesbank Fleet, as well as the Automotive Association of South Africa. Based in Samrand Business Park, Centurion, Samrand Panel Beaters suits motorists with an insurance claim as much as those paying for repairs directly.

SEESA, based in Brummeria, Pretoria, is trusted by more than 30,000 employers across South Africa for labour law and legal compliance support, helping businesses manage the legal and compliance risk that comes with employing staff. Its core labour service covers everything from contracts of employment to terminations, alongside dedicated CCMA dispute support.

The firm's B-BBEE consultants guide clients to strategic compliance, while its Occupational Health and Safety solution simplifies that side of the business, and its Skills Training offering bundles employee training, skills levy claims and employment equity assistance into one package. Payroll, UIF and Compensation Fund administration runs through SEESA's own Connect platform. Based in Brummeria, Pretoria, SEESA suits employers wanting labour law, compliance and payroll support from a single long-established partner.

Simo's Coffee Roastery, at Karoo Square on Lynnwood Road, has roasted coffee on demand since 2013 using a 15kg manual roaster rather than large-scale automated equipment. All of its beans are 100% Arabica, drawn from varieties including Bourbon, Catuai, Mundo Novo, Tipica, Caturra and Heirloom sourced from eight different countries, including a full-body decaffeinated coffee from Colombia and an organic coffee from Honduras.

Its five signature blends, Italian, Espresso Gold, Karoo Blend, Mocca Java and Blue Mountain, are sold alongside brewing equipment such as hand grinders and Hario V60 drippers from its on-site coffee shop, where customers can also sit and enjoy a cup. Based in The Willows, Pretoria, Simo's Coffee Roastery suits home brewers and coffee shops alike wanting freshly roasted, single-origin-aware Arabica coffee rather than a generic commercial blend.

SL Consulting, based in Glen Lauriston, Pretoria, draws on more than 28 years of experience collaborating with building offices at city councils across Gauteng to help clients turn an idea into an approved building plan. Its design service covers drawing up plans for a new home, a development, or an extension to an existing building, tailored to what the client wants to build.

Once a plan is ready, SL Consulting submits it to the relevant city council building office and manages the approval process on the client's behalf, flagging that councils themselves control how long that process takes. Once a plan is approved, the client can move into the building phase with SL Consulting's support. Based in Glen Lauriston, Pretoria, SL Consulting suits homeowners and developers needing building plans designed and taken through council approval by specialists who know the local process.

SoReal Solutions, based in Highveld, Centurion, provides IT support and cloud services with more than 20 years in the industry, covering on-site support, SLA-backed remote support, and N+1 cloud hosting with custom cloud solutions. Its network solutions team designs and implements networks businesses can depend on, while its hardware and software licensing service covers products from the industry's top companies.

The business also offers managed business SIM cards and APN connectivity with usage monitoring, VoIP and hosted PBX services, Microsoft 365 support, and backups and disaster recovery, alongside data centre hosting on physical servers in Johannesburg or Pretoria or on a virtualised cloud platform. Based in Highveld, Centurion, SoReal Solutions suits businesses across Gauteng wanting IT support, cloud hosting and cybersecurity handled by one long-established provider.

SSC Group, established in 2005 and based in Highveld, Pretoria, is a diversified company operating across mining, mining rehabilitation and exploration, and drilling, alongside advisory and human capital services. That mix lets the group serve mining clients across the full project cycle, from exploration and drilling through to rehabilitation once operations wind down.

Beyond mining, SSC Group has expanded into renewable energy, SMME development and digital agency work, and holds B-BBEE Level 1 status as a majority black-women owned enterprise. Based in Highveld, Pretoria, SSC Group suits mining clients needing exploration through rehabilitation services from one group, as well as businesses wanting renewable energy or SMME development support from a B-BBEE Level 1 partner.

STC Ingco Concept Store, trading as Silverton Tool Centre, stocks an extensive range of tools and equipment from power drills to hand saws, serving both professional tradespeople and DIY enthusiasts in Silverton, Pretoria. Its categories cover gardening equipment, gas and gas accessories, hand tools, hardware, locks, pneumatic equipment and power tools and consumables.

Beyond retail stock, the store offers key cutting, number plate services and bicycle repair, giving customers a reason to visit beyond just buying tools. Based in Silverton, Pretoria, STC Ingco Concept Store suits tradespeople needing a dependable local tool supplier as well as DIY customers and cyclists wanting repairs or key cutting done in the same visit.

Supertec Ceilings & Drywall, in Rooihuiskraal, Centurion, is the local branch of one of South Africa's leading ceiling and partitioning manufacturers and distributors, which operates a distribution network of 12 branches backed by a large delivery fleet. Its ceiling systems range covers Main Tees, Cross Tees, galvanised angles, pre-painted wall trims, ceiling tiles and ceiling board.

On the partitioning side, the branch supplies drywall, stud and track systems, gypsum board, fire-rated and moisture-resistant board, insulation, and the screws, anchors and jointing compounds needed to install them, alongside acoustic ceiling solutions for offices, shopping centres, meeting rooms and educational facilities. Based in Rooihuiskraal, Centurion, Supertec Ceilings & Drywall suits shopfitters and contractors needing ceiling, partitioning and acoustic products sourced from one national distributor.

T.Y.D. Construction, in business since 1993 and based in Leeuwfontein, Pretoria, builds residential luxury homes, house extensions and additions, and commercial projects including office blocks and factories across Pretoria, Midrand, Cullinan, Bela-Bela and Brits. The company works only with partners in architecture and design it considers credible, aiming to realise the client's true vision for a new house, extension, factory or office block rather than a generic result.

Its expert, no-nonsense and client-centric approach to construction and project management has built a name in the industry over more than three decades of operation, and the business is NHBRC-registered, giving clients the protections that registration carries on a new home build. Based in Leeuwfontein, Pretoria, T.Y.D. Construction suits clients building a new luxury home as much as those commissioning a commercial factory or office block.

Takelight Log Cabin Projects, based in Pretoria North, has more than six years of experience and has completed over 136 projects designing, constructing and renovating timber homes. Its range covers log cabins and Nutec homes from one to four bedrooms, built from either a pre-existing floor plan or a layout designed specifically for the client.

That combination of volume and customisation gives clients a choice between a proven, pre-existing design and a fully bespoke layout, depending on budget and how specific their requirements are. Based in Heatherview, Pretoria, Takelight Log Cabin Projects suits homeowners wanting a timber home, granny flat or additional living space built faster than a conventional brick structure.

TH-Vision Technologies, based near Zwavelpoort, Pretoria East, is a South African ICT company offering professional ICT consulting, ICT support, web design and development, and mobile application development through its various departments. Its solutions are built to be open and minimise vendor lock-in, giving clients the freedom to choose the applications and hardware that suit their business as it grows, rather than being tied to one platform.

The company also runs a company registration service, handling registrations, director amendments and annual return submissions as a private entity rather than a government department, alongside domain registration and hosting for co.za, .com, .net and .org domains. Open Monday to Thursday from 8:30am to 5pm and Fridays from 8:30am to 3pm, TH-Vision suits businesses across Gauteng, the Free State, Western Cape, Limpopo and North West needing ICT development and company compliance support from one provider.

The Capital Menlyn Maine, in the heart of the Menlyn Maine precinct, offers contemporary hotel rooms, luxury apartments and spacious penthouses, with direct access to the precinct's retail, restaurants and bars and its own Camelot Spa. Guests staying for business can use the hotel's modern conference centre and fitness centre, while breakfast is served at the on-site Koi restaurant, bar and lounge from 6:30am to 10:30am.

Security and convenience are built into the stay, with 24-hour controlled security access and secure, complimentary parking, alongside an outdoor swimming pool for guests wanting to unwind after a day of meetings or shopping. Based in Menlyn, Pretoria, The Capital Menlyn Maine suits business travellers needing boardroom time and conference facilities as much as leisure guests wanting apartment-style accommodation in a central, walkable precinct.

The Croc Meat Company is a wholesale butchery specialising in crocodile, or kwena, meat and sausages, alongside venison and other game meats, supplying resellers, restaurants and chesanyama outlets as well as the general public. All of the meat it sells is processed at registered abattoirs, giving customers assurance on food safety for a product category that falls outside standard beef and poultry butchery.

Orders are delivered across Gauteng, with bulk delivery available to Durban and Cape Town for customers further afield needing larger volumes. Open daily from 8am to 4pm, The Croc Meat Company is based in Wolmer, Pretoria, and suits restaurants and resellers wanting a reliable wholesale source of crocodile and game meat as much as individual customers trying it for the first time.

The Waste Group provides waste removal, recycling and landfill management for domestic, commercial, industrial and municipal clients, with branches across Gauteng, North West, Mpumalanga, Limpopo and KwaZulu-Natal. Its services cover domestic and garden waste removal, building rubble removal, school and municipal waste removal, commercial waste management, and medical, hazardous, mining and industrial waste handling.

The company owns two private landfill sites in Gauteng, at Bon Accord and Mooiplaats, and is developing what it describes as the country's first integrated Waste City at the Mooiplaats site, a project it says could serve the province's waste disposal needs for the next 60 years. Based in Onderstepoort, Pretoria, The Waste Group suits municipalities and industrial clients needing waste removal and long-term landfill capacity from one operator.

TheBuyerSam, based in Centurion Golf Estate, draws on more than 30 years of experience in the Mild Steel industry, supplying industrial steel and security fencing products including Vista-Mesh security fencing and Sharp Metal Pressings items such as razor spikes, palisade and pool fencing. Acting as an official agent for major South African steel manufacturers, the business serves clients locally and cross-border into Zimbabwe, with plans to expand further into Africa and across the water to Madagascar, Seychelles and Mauritius.

Its client base spans construction, building, civil and engineering contractors, automotive, retail shopfitting, metalwork contractors and general and precision engineering, reflecting the broad range of sectors that rely on mild steel. Based in Centurion Golf Estate, TheBuyerSam suits contractors and manufacturers across these sectors needing a steel procurement partner rather than sourcing directly from mills themselves.

Tremco has specialised in roof repairs, waterproofing and roof painting for more than 30 years, working across tile, zinc, flat, concrete and metal roofs for clients in Pretoria, Centurion, Midrand and Johannesburg. Its services include replacing an existing roof once corrosion or wear has set in, repairing zinc roofs and box gutters, and waterproofing and painting both zinc and tile roofs.

Beyond roofing, the company handles concrete roof work, balcony and shower waterproofing, and damp-proofing and painting of internal and external walls, giving it a broader remit than a roofing specialist alone. Open Monday to Saturday from 6am to 6pm, Tremco is based in Andeon, Pretoria, and suits homeowners and businesses needing a roof repaired or a damp problem solved by a contractor who also handles the painting finish.

Tswaing Meteorite Crater, a Ditsong museum site, is one of only four known impact craters in South Africa and one of roughly 170 known impact craters in the world, formed by an asteroid strike roughly 200,000 years ago. It is also one of only four meteorite crater museums anywhere in the world, alongside sites in the United States, Germany and France, and is considered one of the best-preserved impact craters globally.

Unlike comparable craters elsewhere, visitors can walk right down into Tswaing, also known as Soutpan, via a hiking trail of about 7.5 kilometres that takes two to three hours and passes the ruins of a former salt-mining operation. Open Monday to Friday from 7:30am to 4pm and weekends from 6am to 2pm, Tswaing Meteorite Crater is based in Soshanguve and suits hikers and anyone curious about one of the world's most accessible meteorite impact sites.

Ultimate Stationery, based in Hermanstad, Pretoria, sells office supplies both in-store and online across categories including stationery, back-to-school supplies, writing and marking instruments, books, document storage, office furniture, office machines and printer cartridges. Brands on its shelves include Sappi and Typek paper, Hewlett Packard ink and toner cartridges, Cadii school cases and Fellowes office shredders.

Orders over R300 qualify for free delivery across Gauteng, with a R90 shipping fee applying below that threshold, and the business offers 30-day accounts for business customers wanting to order on credit. Based in Hermanstad, Pretoria, Ultimate Stationery suits households stocking up for the school term as much as businesses needing an ongoing office supplies account.

Universal Signs & Advertising, a family owned and run business formed in 1975, has grown from humble beginnings into a signage company supplying signage and printing services across South Africa and exporting to most African countries. Its work is manufactured in-house at a signage factory in Villieria and a fully staffed metalwork factory in Koedoespoort equipped with the latest machinery and an on-site spray booth, capable of producing any type of steel work.

Clients have included Ford Motor Company, Toyota, Timber City, Telkom SA, the University of Pretoria and numerous government and private businesses, alongside branded apparel, embroidery and display products such as gazebos and roll-up banners. Based in Koedoespoort, Pretoria, Universal Signs & Advertising suits businesses needing signage, printing and metal fabrication manufactured by one long-established supplier.

Vavro Plastics, established in 1960 in Rosslyn, manufactures custom PVC and polypropylene products for the promotional, printing and stationery industries, including ring binders, folders, document holders, travel wallets and packaging. Its products can be branded using silkscreen printing, embossing or encapsulation, giving customers several finishing options depending on the look and durability they need.

More than six decades in the plastics industry have given the company a long-standing position supplying printers, promotional companies and stationers rather than selling directly to end consumers. Based in Rosslyn, Pretoria, Vavro Plastics suits printing and promotional businesses needing custom-branded binders, folders or packaging manufactured locally rather than imported.

Wolff Logistics traces back to Wolff Commercial Vehicles opening its doors in April 1997, with the logistics division beginning operations in January 2010 and the fleet now running at over 300 trucks on the road. The company rents out a wide variety of vehicles from 1 to 8 tons, including van bodies, dropsides, fridge trucks, curtain sides and crane trucks, with free kilometres included on every truck hire.

Alongside rentals, Wolff Logistics sells commercial vehicles and runs its own workshop for truck repairs and servicing, and offers a comprehensive fleet management solution for businesses needing their transport handled as one package. Based in Boekenhoutskloof, Pretoria, Wolff Logistics suits businesses needing a truck rented for a short job as much as those wanting an ongoing fleet management partner.

World Link Consulting, based in Midstream Ridge, is an SAP partner offering SAP ERP implementation and configuration designed around each client's strategic processes, alongside SAP Mobile App Development using SAP Fiori and SAPUI5 for an enhanced mobile experience. Its Business Value service specialises in SAP Managed Services, aiming to reduce turnaround time and increase value across a client's business processes using proven methods.

On the reporting side, the company builds dashboards powered by SAP Analytics Cloud and big data, helping executives and stakeholders make informed decisions, and it also supports RISE with SAP and S/4HANA Cloud migrations and SAP resourcing for clients needing contractors. Based in Midstream Ridge, Pretoria, World Link Consulting suits government, mining, retail and oil and gas clients needing SAP implementation, mobile development or managed services from one partner.

Airbag Services, trading as Airbag Testing and Training (Pty) Ltd, has offered a specialist OEM electronic airbag fitment and repair service to the automotive, insurance and mining industries since 2003. The company entered into a service agreement with the South African Bureau of Standards to help develop and publish South African National Standards for airbag fitment and test centres, and for the non-destructive testing of airbag inflator modules under SABS ARP068.

Its founder conducted airbag study tours in the USA and UK and trained at specialist airbag companies abroad before building out the business's own range of airbag-related products and services, including retrofit airbags, airbag repair, service and maintenance, airbag testing, airbag training, and work on seat belts and control systems. Based in Waverley, Pretoria, Airbag Services suits motor manufacturers, insurers and repairers needing airbag work certified to a recognised non-destructive testing standard.

Alumo Energy, with its Pretoria branch in Nieuw Muckleneuk, is a solar engineering, procurement and construction company offering panel installation, maintenance and battery back-up solutions across a countrywide network of seven branches. Customers can buy a system outright, rent it over 3, 5 or 7 years with the option to buy it out at the end of the term, or subscribe, with packages such as The Power Bae, Watt-a-Deal and The Big Watt matched to the size of a household's monthly electricity bill.

Rental systems typically pair a Solis inverter with an Eenovance battery and a matched number of solar panels, backed by a 10-year warranty on the core components. Open Monday to Friday from 7am to 6pm and Saturdays from 8am to 2pm, Alumo Energy suits households and businesses wanting a solar system matched to their bill size without having to pay for it outright.

Amberfield College, in Rooihuiskraal North, Centurion, opened in 2019 under the management of the Royal Schools group, offering the IEB curriculum from Grade RRR to Grade 12 and now teaching around 1,770 learners. The school positions itself on all-inclusive school fees with no surprise extras, pricing itself around 20% below comparable schools in the area.

Its balanced approach combines academics with sport and culture, backed by state-of-the-art facilities across all three areas, and the school draws on its management group's longer track record in private education despite being a newer campus itself. Based in Amberfield, Centurion, Amberfield College suits families wanting an IEB private school with newer facilities at a lower fee than comparable schools nearby.

Aroma Coffee Roastery & Gelato, in the In Shere Centre at Silver Lakes, is a branch of the Aroma Gourmet Coffee Roastery chain, which roasts its own coffee beans and caters to coffee drinkers ranging from home brewers to busy offices and cafes. The Silver Lakes branch serves specialty roasted coffee alongside a fresh lunch menu and more than fifty gelato flavours, including vegan and diabetic-friendly options.

Customers can also order roasted or unroasted coffee beans directly from the brand for home delivery, and the Silver Lakes branch is available for private functions for groups wanting to book the space outside normal trading hours.
